hypothesis.H_RX1: First-class explicit resource state exposed by Sluice (AC-1a accessors) materially improves bottleneck attribution over conventional process/kernel telemetry for controlled ThreadPool workloads.
hypothesis.H0: External telemetry is sufficient, or Sluice L1 signals do not improve attribution enough to justify deeper observability work.

label_set_note: UNKNOWN is a legitimate classifier response (insufficient or contradictory evidence), never a ground-truth injection class. IO_SERVICE_CONTENDED is DEFERRED: workload files live on tmpfs (no device service), iostat is unavailable, and WSL2 virtual storage makes device-level ground truth ambiguous. ENVIRONMENT INVALID / DEFERRED.

sampling.observer: sequential individual AC-1a accessor calls, sleep_until pacing, bounded preallocated storage, aggregates-only output; no combined snapshot exists by design

feature_definitions.units_note: see research/rx1/scripts/rx1_classify.py extract_features(); the whitelist there is normative
common_perf: task_clock_s (perf unavailable events recorded as absent)
feature_definitions.fairness: identical static config, outcome, OS accounting, PSI and perf features are available to BOTH classifiers; E adds exactly the AC-1a accessor aggregates; neither classifier ever sees intervention identity, affinity, stress parameters, run index or ground-truth metadata

rule_precedence: 1 CPU_CONTENDED if psi_cpu_some > 250000 us/s (CPU contention legitimately produces secondary internal queueing; it outranks internal rules)
2 UNKNOWN if capacity and worker rules fire simultaneously (incompatible strong causes)
3 REQUEST_CAPACITY_LIMITED: C = caller-observed rejections > 0; E = sluice rejections_delta > 0 AND frac_slot_at_capacity >= 0.30
4 THREADPOOL_WORKER_LIMITED: C = per_worker_util >= 1.10 AND psi quiet AND no rejections; E = frac_active_at_configured >= 0.55 AND dispatch_occ_mean >= 10 AND psi quiet AND no rejections
5 APP_PIPELINE_LIMITED: C = cpu_cores_used <= 2.0 AND depth/capacity <= 0.10 AND no rejections; E = same external conditions AND slot_occ_mean <= 0.10 AND frac_active <= 0.30 AND no rejections
6 CONTROL: C = cpu_cores_used >= 0.75 AND no rejections AND psi quiet; E = same AND frac_active < 0.55 AND frac_slot_at_capacity < 0.30 AND no rejections
7 IO_SERVICE_CONTENDED if psi_io_some > 50000 us/s (deferred class; rule present, expected never to fire on tmpfs)
unknown_policy: UNKNOWN when no rule crosses its threshold, or when capacity+worker rules fire together. UNKNOWN rate is reported separately from wrong-cause rate.

formal_matrix.calibration_cell: read/65536 (the pilot shape; other 5 cells are hold-out)

run_policy.file_policy: tmpfs /tmp, one file per size shared by read/write (identical deterministic pattern), pre-created and cache-warmed by one unrecorded read pass before each phase; NO drop_caches; experiment tests runtime/resource attribution, not physical-device service
run_policy.external_counters_window: PSI/perf/wall span the whole bench process (recorded); bench-internal counters span the measured window only
run_policy.perf_events: task-clock,context-switches,cpu-migrations,cycles,instructions,branches,branch-misses (perf_event_paranoid=2: user-space only; missing events recorded as absent)

randomization_note: random.Random(seed); cell order shuffled independently per workload block and for the tax block; controls interleaved by construction; seed fixed BEFORE formal execution
warmup_policy: 1 unrecorded in-process warmup repetition before the measured window (page-cache + steady state), plus the pre-recorded file pre-creation pass

invalid_rules.general: a run is INVALID_RUN (excluded from scoring, reported in invalid-rate) when its ground truth did not manifest; INVALID is not classifier failure or success
invalid_rules.CONTROL: no rejections; arena not persistently at capacity (frac < 0.30); workers not saturated (frac_active < 0.55); PSI cpu below gate
invalid_rules.APP_PIPELINE_LIMITED: no rejections; no internal saturation; injected depth <= 4
invalid_rules.REQUEST_CAPACITY_LIMITED: rejections_delta > 0 AND arena_high_water == capacity AND capacity < offered depth
invalid_rules.THREADPOOL_WORKER_LIMITED: frac_active >= 0.50 AND frac_dispatch_nonzero >= 0.25 AND capacity rejection not dominant AND workers < offered depth
invalid_rules.IO_SERVICE_CONTENDED: deferred; always invalid in this environment
invalid_rules.correctness: any incorrect output/byte accounting/lifecycle failure invalidates the run (bench exits non-zero; all_reps_ok false)

primary_metrics: Top-1 attribution accuracy (C, E) over valid runs
wrong-cause rate (confident misattribution) reported separately from UNKNOWN rate
primary comparison: delta accuracy = accuracy(E) - accuracy(C) with paired bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, bootstrap seed 1701)
paired transition table wrong->right / unknown->right / right->wrong / right->unknown
observability tax: OFF/LOW/HIGH throughput, p50/p99 latency, cpu cores, context switches per kop

verdict_thresholds.SUPPORTED ENOUGH TO DEEPEN: delta accuracy >= +15pp AND paired 95% CI excludes zero on the positive side AND improvement not solely from one trivial class AND E does not materially increase wrong-cause rate AND OBS-LOW median throughput tax <= 2% with no convincing systematic tail regression > ~5%
verdict_thresholds.PROMISING BUT INSUFFICIENT: positive direction but one or more gates unmet; does NOT authorize AC-1b
verdict_thresholds.ENGINEERING VALUE ONLY: AC-1a useful for direct debugging/resource display but attribution gain too small for the research thesis; keep cheap metrics, do not deepen research infrastructure
verdict_thresholds.NOT SUPPORTED / STOP EXPANSION: delta <= 0, or E materially increases wrong-cause rate, or gain tiny relative to observation tax, or failure to generalize outside calibration cells; recommend stopping deeper observability research

freeze_note: Committed before formal execution. Classifier rules, thresholds, sampling intervals, severities, matrix, seed and verdict thresholds are immutable from this point; any harness bug requires a protocol_version bump and full formal rerun. Pilot data (results/pilot/) is calibration evidence only and is never counted as formal evaluation data.
